result.summary: The tenant's SMS (event 006) asks whether we got their earlier message about the dishwasher. That job is already approved (landlord, up to £120, event 002) and booked by the contractor for Tue 7 Oct 10:00–12:00 (events 003–005). I sent the tenant one short SMS confirming we have their message and the booking still stands. I also moved the ticket forward from intake to scheduling, since it was behind the evidence, recorded the landlord's £120 cap, and set a hold to follow up after the visit. No contractor action or escalation is needed.

judgement.why_this_decision: Event 006 repeats an earlier message about a job that is already approved (event 002), confirmed by the contractor (event 003), passed on to the tenant (event 004) and acknowledged (event 005). The classifier read it as a plain question (0.99) with no safety concern (0.02) and low dissatisfaction (0.13). The visit is the next morning, so one short reply confirming the booking settles the tenant's question and helps make sure someone is home to let the contractor in. Nothing else needed doing apart from bringing the CRM up to date.

The contractor already confirmed in event 003 and nothing has suggested a change. Chasing them again would be unnecessary.
There is no conflict, complaint, safety risk or cost issue.
